label: Tuesday, Again
summary: Every day is Tuesday, October 14th, and at 11:42 someone dies. You are the only one who remembers. Today is loop one.
title: Tuesday, Again
description: You stopped in Calder Falls for one night on a road trip. You have now lived the same Tuesday once, and you are about to find out you will live it again. At 11:42 tonight, someone in town dies, the day resets, and only you remember. Find out who, why, and how to make it stop.

chapterOutlines.title: Loop One
chapterOutlines.outline: Live the Tuesday once, without knowing what is coming.

chapterOutlines.title: Learning the Day
chapterOutlines.outline: Use the loops to learn the town, its people and its secrets.
Find out who dies, and why you cannot save them the easy way.

chapterOutlines.title: Wednesday
chapterOutlines.outline: Break the loop, if you can.

scene.location: Room 6 of the Pine Rest Motel, Calder Falls, 6:00 a.m.
scene.summary: The radio alarm plays a song about October. The weather report promises a storm at nine. Somewhere across the road, a diner is opening.

openThreads: Why are you the one who remembers?

npcs.name: June Calloway
npcs.description: The owner of the Falls Diner, who serves pie, pours coffee and knows everybody's business. She says the same thing to you every morning.

npcs.name: Sheriff Ray Dunmore
npcs.description: The town sheriff, close to retirement, who has seen something like this before and does not want to talk about it.
goals: Get through one more quiet day

npcs.name: Wes Park
npcs.description: The high school physics teacher, who has a chalkboard full of equations about time in his garage and a lot of coffee.

items.name: Wristwatch
items.description: It stopped at 11:42 last night and starts again every morning at 6:00.

items.name: Motel key
items.description: Room 6. You always wake up here.
